Sorcha O Donnell is one of the guides overseeing the care for the iconic castle that has been called home by many colourful characters, from an infamous landlord to an elite art collector. Of the extensive art collection, some paintings are in need of off-site restoration, while the frosty winter weather demands special care for the garden antiquities, including mythological statues shipped from Florence. The house has deep ties to its local community, who have been both scarred and entranced by the residents and famous guests.

programme.title: Great Irish Interiors

For Curator and Collections Manager Cathal Dowd Smith, the off-season is a chance to undertake some conservation works on the exterior and roof. On the inside, cracked wallpaper needs professional care and some priceless curtains need freezing to kill any insects.

Sorcha O Donnell is one of the guides overseeing the care for the iconic castle that has been called home by many colourful characters, from an infamous landlord to an elite art collector. Of the extensive art collection, some paintings are in need of off-site restoration, while the frosty winter weather demands special care for the garden antiquities, including mythological statues shipped from Florence. The house has deep ties to its local community, who have been both scarred and entranced by the residents and famous guests.

Of the extensive art collection, some paintings are in need of off-site restoration, while the frosty winter weather demands special care for the garden antiquities, including mythological statues shipped from Florence. The house has deep ties to its local community, who have been both scarred and entranced by the residents and famous guests.

On the inside, cracked wallpaper needs professional care and some priceless curtains need freezing to kill any insects.

programme.title: Faking Influence
programme.desc: In the final episode of The Feed's investigation into the murky world of influencers, reporter Calliste Weitenberg and producer Elise Potaka reveal their account as a fake. They confront Instagram and the social media agency that promoted them, despite the fact that their follower count was fake and brands asked them to break the rules and hide the truth. With nearly no regulation of the $15 billion industry, who should be held accountable for shonky practices on influencers' social media pages?

The house has deep ties to its local community, who have been both scarred and entranced by the residents and famous guests.

programme.title: Great Irish Interiors
programme.desc: Newbridge House in Donabate, Dublin, is an 18th century Palladian villa in the care of Fingal County Council. For Curator and Collections Manager Cathal Dowd Smith, the off-season is a chance to undertake some conservation works on the exterior and roof. On the inside, cracked wallpaper needs professional care and some priceless curtains need freezing to kill any insects.

programme.title: Make Up: A Glamorous History
programme.desc: Lisa Eldridge explores the peacocks of British history: the Georgians. The glamour of the look grew out of the turbulent history of the age. A period of extreme ostentation not seen again until the 20th century.

programme.title: Insight
programme.desc: What do extreme sports, doomscrolling, addiction, Parkinson's disease, and ADHD all have in common? Dopamine. This crucial neurotransmitter helps facilitate pleasure, reward, motivation, memory and movement within the body, but is that always a good thing? Insight explores when the activation of dopamine can lead to pleasure, or pain.

Sorcha O Donnell is one of the guides overseeing the care for the iconic castle that has been called home by many colourful characters, from an infamous landlord to an elite art collector. Of the extensive art collection, some paintings are in need of off-site restoration, while the frosty winter weather demands special care for the garden antiquities, including mythological statues shipped from Florence. The house has deep ties to its local community, who have been both scarred and entranced by the residents and famous guests.

programme.title: Great Irish Interiors

On the inside, cracked wallpaper needs professional care and some priceless curtains need freezing to kill any insects.
